blocks.text: A browser route app needs its static host to return the app shell for supported client-side addresses. Otherwise a direct visit can fail before React runs.

Use React Router 7 framework mode, the continuation of Remix's framework approach. Save files at the shown app paths. Set ssr:false in react-router.config.ts for this browser-only course. React tooling is required.

blocks.code:
Run the project build command.
Serve the generated build/client files.
Configure the static host fallback to index.html for client routes.
Open /books directly in a new tab.
Check that real asset requests still return their actual files.
blocks.title: Serve the browser build

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: A direct route visit first reaches the static host, before React Router runs.
The route fallback supplies the app shell, while actual asset requests still need their proper file responses.

blocks.text: Both link navigation and direct route visits can open the app when the host fallback is correct.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not return HTML for a missing JavaScript file. Keep asset handling separate from route fallback behaviour.
